nodes.name: Vectơ bằng nhau
nodes.description: Hai vectơ có cùng độ dài và cùng hướng.

assignments.rationale: Both occurrences describe the same mathematical concept: two vectors are equal if they have the same length and direction. The grade difference (10 vs. 12) is not a reason to split, as the core definition is identical. The slight variation in the name ('Hai vectơ bằng nhau' vs. 'Vectơ bằng nhau') refers to the same concept.
